Author: EvolvedXIV
Name: Party Icons Evolved
Punchline: Highly customizable job icons and raid role indicators on party nameplates.
Description:
Customises the nameplates above your party members using the game's own nameplate UI.

- Show or hide the name, shorten it to a maximum length (on top of the game's own Display Name Settings) and recolour it.
- Add a job icon with configurable style, position and size.
- Add a raid role indicator (MT, OT, H1, H2, M1, M2, R1, R2) with configurable colours.
- Roles are assigned automatically, by a party chat message that contains only the role (e.g. "M1"), or from the right-click menu.

Open the settings with /pie.

Author: EvolvedXIV
Name: Job Gauge Evolved
Description:
Draws improved job gauges that you can resize, move and recolour, with a settings section and an on/off switch per job. Game windows cover the gauges like they cover the game's own.

Viper: the Vipersight blades and the Serpent Offerings gauge in one. A blade lights up when the game would recommend its button from your Honed and venom buffs, and goes dark when the buffs run out. At the finisher a glow around the orb shows a flank or a rear attack, and the blade of the finisher your venom empowers lights up with it. Lit parts glow with a pulse of energy every 2 seconds, and a lit blade's colour is added to its steel; the centre's colours and glow are set apart from the blades'. Also shows the Anguine Tributes and the Reawaken timer, the gauge value and your Rattling Coils.

Open the settings with /jge.

Author: Styr1x - EvolvedXIV Fix
Name: Browsingway Evolved
Description:
Renders browser overlays in-game to enable playing in fullscreen (and G-SYNC) while having access to ACT overlays.
Use the settings button below or the '/bw config' command to configure.
Based on the BrowserHost plugin by ackwell.
Changelog:
- Overlays recover after the render process restarts, instead of staying on the error screen until the plugin is toggled
- Renamed to Browsingway Evolved (internal name BrowsingwayEvolved) so it can be installed from the EvolvedXIV repository
- Fix the render process randomly failing to start (FileNotFoundException when opening its IPC channel), which needed a game restart to recover
- Api 15
